result.analyst_notes: Confident, first-person plural voice, mixing aspirational claims (aspire to be the world's most trusted company) with factual metrics (30 percent water reduction). Leads with products and quality, then business strength, then community and sustainability. Commitments range from absolute ('always aims') to hedged ('Plans are under way'). Brand slogan 'Go Further' recurs.
